summary: The Network Service Header (NSH) has an O bit that marks operations, administration, and maintenance packets, but RFC 8300 left the meaning of "OAM packet" ambiguous. This short document clarifies what is meant and how the bit should be handled. It updates RFC 8300.

eli5.summary: A rulebook had a sign that said "test packet" but nobody agreed what that meant. This note explains it clearly so everyone follows the sign the same way.
